affiliate.api_details: RedSky API is publicly accessible with API key embedded in target.com page source (key: 9f36aeafbe60771e321a7cc95a78140772ab3e96). Provides product search, details, pricing, fulfillment, store inventory, and reviews. This is the BEST undocumented JSON API among all retailers.

notes: Target has the most scraper-friendly architecture. Their RedSky API (redsky.target.com) is publicly accessible with a key extractable from page source. No bot protection on API endpoints. Product pages are Next.js SSR but API bypasses this. PLP API returns JSON with product cards, prices, ratings, images, and availability. TCIN (Target ID) extracted from /A-{tcin} pattern. Clearance category has dedicated URL path.
